content.short: DipDup is a Python framework for building smart contract indexers.
content.description: DipDup is a Python framework for building smart contract indexers. It keeps developers focused on business logic by eliminating boilerplate code needed to store and serve data, so you can implement indexing rules without worrying about data plumbing. Indexers built with DipDup are selective, requesting only the data that matters. This targeted approach leads to faster indexing and reduced load on the APIs and services you rely on, helping you scale data access efficiently.
